import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path.cwd()
scratch = Path(__file__).parent
evidence = root / 'docs/features/active/2026-10-17-legacy-discovery-and-parity-980/evidence/regression-testing'
paths = ['packages/discovery-runtime/src/drm_copilot_discovery/analyzer/dependency_dotnet.py', 'tests/discovery_runtime/analyzer/test_dependency_dotnet.py']
label, stage = sys.argv[1:3]
coverage_path = scratch / (label + '-coverage.json')
commands = {
    'format': ['poetry', 'run', 'black', *paths],
    'lint': ['poetry', 'run', 'ruff', 'check', *paths],
    'types': ['poetry', 'run', 'pyright', *paths],
    'unit': ['poetry', 'run', 'pytest', paths[1], '-o', 'addopts=', '-v', '--cov=drm_copilot_discovery.analyzer.dependency_dotnet', '--cov-branch', '--cov-report=term-missing', '--cov-report=json:' + str(coverage_path)],
}
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def bindings():
    return {p: {'sha256': sha((root/p).read_bytes()), 'physical_lines': len((root/p).read_bytes().splitlines())} for p in paths}
def portable(value):
    return value.replace(str(scratch), 'SCRATCH').replace(scratch.as_posix(), 'SCRATCH').replace(str(root), 'WORKSPACE').replace(root.as_posix(), 'WORKSPACE')
before = bindings()
start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
timer = time.monotonic()
environment = os.environ.copy()
environment['COVERAGE_FILE'] = str(scratch / (label + '.coverage'))
result = subprocess.run(commands[stage], capture_output=True, env=environment)
end = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
stamp = end.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M')
streams = {}
for name, data in [('stdout', result.stdout), ('stderr', result.stderr)]:
    raw = scratch / (label + '-' + stage + '.' + end.strftime('%H%M%S%f') + '.' + name + '.bin')
    raw.write_bytes(data)
    streams[name] = {'scratch_identifier': 'SCRATCH/' + raw.name, 'raw_sha256': sha(data), 'raw_bytes': len(data), 'presentation': portable(data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))}
receipt = {'stage': stage, 'command': portable(subprocess.list2cmdline(commands[stage])), 'started': start.isoformat(), 'finished': end.isoformat(), 'duration_seconds': round(time.monotonic()-timer,3), 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'source_before': before, 'source_after': bindings(), 'streams': streams, 'harness': {'path': 'SCRATCH/'+Path(__file__).name, 'sha256': sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())}, 'baseline': 'shared 09:44 absent-path baseline; checked contract 1dd386135f0f52c247d7b85ccd766cbc63ebaf4d'}
target = evidence / (label + '-' + stage + '.' + stamp)
target.with_suffix('.json') if False else None
Path(str(target)+'.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
Path(str(target)+'.md').write_text('# P4-T7 .NET parser scoped gate\n\nTimestamp: '+stamp+'\nCommand: '+receipt['command']+'\nEXIT_CODE: '+str(result.returncode)+'\n\nPath rendering uses WORKSPACE and SCRATCH tokens; exact streams are preserved by hash.\n\n```text\n'+streams['stdout']['presentation']+streams['stderr']['presentation']+'\n```\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'receipt': str(target.relative_to(root))+'.json', 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'seconds': receipt['duration_seconds'], 'bindings': receipt['source_after']}))
print(streams['stdout']['presentation']+streams['stderr']['presentation'])
sys.exit(result.returncode)

import ast
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

root = Path.cwd()
scratch = Path(__file__).parent
folder = root / 'docs/features/active/2026-10-17-legacy-discovery-and-parity-980/evidence/regression-testing'
source = 'packages/discovery-runtime/src/drm_copilot_discovery/analyzer/dependency_dotnet.py'
test = 'tests/discovery_runtime/analyzer/test_dependency_dotnet.py'
stamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M')
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def save(name, data):
    path = folder / (name + '.' + stamp + '.json')
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    return path
def binding(path):
    return {'path': path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), 'sha256': sha(path.read_bytes()), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size}
receipts = sorted(folder.glob('p4t7-dotnet-focused*-*.json'))
gate_source = (scratch / 'p4t7-dotnet-gates.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
older = gate_source.replace("shared_path = root / 'packages/discovery-runtime/src/drm_copilot_discovery/analyzer/dependency_inputs.py'\nshared_before = sha(shared_path.read_bytes())\n", '').replace("'shared_before': shared_before, 'shared_after': sha(shared_path.read_bytes()), ", '')
oldest = older.replace("    'lintfix': ['poetry', 'run', 'ruff', 'check', '--fix', *paths],\n", '')
harnesses = {}
for text in (oldest, older, gate_source):
    raw = text.encode()
    digest = sha(raw)
    path = scratch / ('p4t7-dotnet-gates-' + digest + '.py')
    path.write_bytes(raw)
    harnesses[digest] = {'path': 'SCRATCH/'+path.name, 'sha256': digest, 'source': text}
for path in receipts:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert value['harness']['sha256'] in harnesses, path
    for stream in value['streams'].values():
        raw = scratch / stream['scratch_identifier'].removeprefix('SCRATCH/')
        assert sha(raw.read_bytes()) == stream['raw_sha256'], raw
save('p4t7-dotnet-executed-harnesses', {'gate_versions': list(harnesses.values()), 'freeze_harness': {'path':'SCRATCH/'+Path(__file__).name, 'sha256':sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), 'source':Path(__file__).read_text()}})
coverage_path = scratch / 'p4t7-dotnet-focused6-coverage.json'
coverage_raw = coverage_path.read_bytes()
coverage_target = folder / ('p4t7-dotnet-coverage.'+stamp+'.json')
coverage_target.write_bytes(coverage_raw)
coverage = json.loads(coverage_raw)
metrics = next(iter(coverage['files'].values()))
assert metrics['missing_lines'] == [] and metrics['missing_branches'] == []
executed = set(metrics['executed_lines'])
ranges = []
for node in ast.walk(ast.parse((root/source).read_text())):
    if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
        lines = sorted(executed.intersection(range(node.lineno, node.end_lineno+1)))
        assert lines
        ranges.append({'name':node.name, 'start':node.lineno, 'end':node.end_lineno, 'executed_lines':lines, 'missing_lines':[], 'line_percent':100})
final_receipts = [p for p in receipts if 'focused6-' in p.name]
assert len(final_receipts) == 4
for path in final_receipts:
    receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert receipt['exit_code'] == 0
    assert receipt['source_before'] == receipt['source_after']
    assert receipt['shared_before'] == receipt['shared_after']
    for name in (source, test):
        assert receipt['source_after'][name]['sha256'] == sha((root/name).read_bytes())
unit = json.loads(next(p for p in final_receipts if '-unit.' in p.name).read_text())
nodes = re.findall(r'^(tests/.*) PASSED ', unit['streams']['stdout']['presentation'], re.MULTILINE)
assert len(nodes) == 63
save('p4t7-dotnet-nodes', {'nodes':nodes, 'count':63, 'unit_receipt':binding(next(p for p in final_receipts if '-unit.' in p.name))})
freeze = {'status':'FROZEN_SUBSET_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW', 'source_test':[binding(root/p) for p in (source,test)], 'shared_dependency_sha256':unit['shared_before'], 'coverage':binding(coverage_target), 'summary':metrics['summary'], 'callable_ranges':ranges, 'classes':'No production classes introduced', 'checks':[binding(p) for p in final_receipts], 'timings_seconds':{json.loads(p.read_text())['stage']:json.loads(p.read_text())['duration_seconds'] for p in final_receipts}, 'baseline':'Reuse shared09:44 absent-path baseline and152 shared cases; no predecessor reruns', 'limitations':['Subset proof only; final composed QA and independent review pending','Conservative JSON record ceiling max_nodes//64; tiny budgets fail closed','No build evaluation, central-version activation, imports, restore or installed dependency claims','Shared repairs remain integration-owned; final composition must bind repaired shared bytes'], 'raw_sqlite':{'path':'SCRATCH/p4t7-dotnet-focused6.coverage','sha256':sha((scratch/'p4t7-dotnet-focused6.coverage').read_bytes())}, 'retained_history':[binding(p) for p in receipts]}
freeze_path = save('p4t7-dotnet-freeze',freeze)
note = folder / ('p4t7-dotnet-handoff.'+stamp+'.md')
note.write_text('# P4-T7 .NET parser candidate\n\nTimestamp: '+stamp+'\nCommand: poetry run python SCRATCH/p4t7-dotnet-freeze.py\nEXIT_CODE: 0\n\n63 in-memory cases passed. Black, Ruff and scoped Pyright passed on unchanged bytes. Coverage:126/126 executable lines and66/66 branches; all9 callable ranges100%. Source332lines, tests408lines. Raw streams and SQLite stay in SCRATCH with checksums; coverage JSON has repository-relative paths. Earlier format/import failures remain retained.\n\nEntrypoint: parse_dotnet_dependencies(content, *, format, limits). Selectors: project, packages-config, packages-lock. The result contains sanitized candidates only. Declared operations, version roles and lock edges remain unresolved syntax. Conservative JSON limits use max_nodes//64 structural records; budgets below64 fail closed.\n\nFinal composed validation must bind the repaired shared module. Independent review and task acceptance remain pending. See '+freeze_path.name+' for exact bindings, callable ranges, timings and receipts.\n',encoding='utf-8')
staging = save('p4t7-dotnet-staging-manifest', {'files':[binding(root/p) for p in (source,test)]+[binding(p) for p in sorted(folder.glob('p4t7-dotnet-*')) if p.is_file()], 'review_pending':True})
print(json.dumps({'freeze':binding(freeze_path),'staging_manifest':binding(staging),'source_test':freeze['source_test'],'summary':metrics['summary'],'callables':len(ranges),'shared':unit['shared_before']}))
